 Order

1.
Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.

2. The State petitioner seeks setting aside of the impugned order dated 29.02.2024 in case FIR No.
290/2023 of Police Station Prem Nagar for offence under Sections 498A/304-B/34 IPC.
By way of the impugned order, the present respondent was discharged of offence under Section 498A/304B IPC.
3. Notice be issued to respondent through IO, returnable on 27.11.2025.
